programmatic_review.api_scope_note: Zoho documents mailbox forwarding configuration through account APIs; this investigation did not request wider OAuth scopes or make account changes.
programmatic_review.latest_refresh: Read-only GET account and GET accounts listing rerun on 2026-10-13; setting fields unchanged and no explicit mailForward list was returned. No broader OAuth scope requested; no account settings changed.

capability_review.read_result: The existing single-account and account-list responses did not explicitly return a mailForward list. That does not establish forwarding absence.
capability_review.forwarding_controls: The Zoho API index documents forwarding and delete-Zoho-copy controls as account update (PUT) operations. No write operation was used to inventory them.
capability_review.filter_rules: The API index does not list an endpoint for enumerating mailbox filters. Zoho documents incoming/outgoing filters with automatic CC/BCC actions; console inspection is required.
capability_review.organization_controls: Organization account/policy and archive settings are separate administrative surfaces. No wider OAuth grant or setting change was made.
capability_review.application_level: worker/zoho-mail.mjs sends to the fixed Craig recipient without CC/BCC; the application has no inquiry database. These source-level facts do not establish mailbox or organization copy rules.
capability_review.provider_policy: Zoho publishes Trash recovery and organization eDiscovery/backup behavior; account-level API results do not reveal this organization’s configured retention or named oversight owner.
capability_review.mailbox_forwarding_update_scope_document: Zoho documents PUT forwarding and Zoho-copy deletion controls under ZohoMail.accounts.UPDATE or ZohoMail.organization.accounts.UPDATE; neither scope is the existing read-only accounts grant, and no write call was made.
capability_review.organization_forward_policy_read_scope_d: Zoho documents GET /api/organization/{zoid}/policy/mailForwardPolicy with ZohoMail.organization.policy.READ. No such organization-level grant was requested or verified for this inspection.
